idea.value: Four separate AI-product launch films play at once in a butt-joined 2×2 grid for 11.6 s, so the viewer gets a studio's range and polish in the time of one clip: breadth is the message, and no single cell has to carry the story alone.
evidence: visuals/a1/keyframes.jpg F0 F240 F500 F696: four unrelated products, one per 640×360 quadrant, no gutter
visuals/a1/quad-tl.jpg, quad-tr.jpg, quad-bl.jpg, quad-br.jpg: each quadrant has its own cuts and its own story
No logo, end card or call to action anywhere in 0–11.617 s (visuals/a1/ov-09.jpg)

audience.value: Founders and marketing leads of AI and SaaS start-ups scrolling a professional social feed; the clip reads as a motion studio's portfolio teaser aimed at them.
evidence: All four cells are AI-assistant or SaaS interfaces: prompt fields, chat, generated dashboards, email lists (visuals/a1/ov-00.jpg … ov-09.jpg)
16:9 1280×720, 11.6 s, silent-friendly: no voice (speech-text.json speech.words is empty), text carries every line
Four different brands with no shared mark: points to the maker, not to any one product

value.description: In the first second four different motions start at once and none of them is a still: a sentence dissolves into dots word by word (TL F3–F17), coloured blocks and photos pop into a collage on twos (TR F2–F53), a cursor sits in a glass prompt card over sky and then punch-cuts in to the caret (BL F49), and one large word glides under a blue light streak on navy (BR F9–F66). The eye cannot settle on one cell, so it scans all four, which is what makes the viewer register 'four films' within a second.

value.purpose: Set up four premises in type and abstraction while the sound is almost silent
value.retentionDevice: Each cell is mid-motion on every frame; 3 within-cell cuts (BL 0.817, BR 1.317, BL 2.317) keep the lower row restless while the upper row morphs without cutting
value.content: TL: statement line turns into a row of dots that become a rotating ring. TR: collage of photos and colour blocks with a serif headline typed word by word. BL: a prompt is typed into a glass card, with punch-in and pull-out cuts. BR: a large word under a light streak becomes a glass input pill whose line is typed, deleted and retyped.

value.purpose: The pulse enters; each cell reaches its first character or problem
value.retentionDevice: Loudness steps up about 6.5× at 2.9 s (RMS 1 000 → 6 600, measured); TL turns its dots into a face, TR sweeps to stressed people at desks, BL punches in to the action button, BR's question gets its send button and a click ripple
value.content: TL: dots collapse to a blob, the blob inflates into a sphere and becomes a mint face (2.55–3.40 s). TR: collage slides out in colour blocks to photos of tired office workers (2.5–3.45 s). BL: punch-in to the action button, cursor hovers. BR: line scrolls with the caret, send button slides in, cursor clicks (3.05–4.5 s).

value.purpose: First wave of product reveals: every cell leaves its opening and shows a product screen
value.retentionDevice: 4 boundaries in 1.07 s (5.017 BR, 5.167 TL, 5.75 BL, 6.083 TL) spread across three cells, never two at once
value.content: BR flies the pill into the lens and cuts to a white chat with an avatar where the send button was. TL cuts from the face to a minimal assistant search bar, then punches in on it and starts typing a question. BL dissolves to a warm gradient placeholder that resolves cell by cell into a generated analytics screen. TR washes to white and fades in a one-line serif promise with a gradient on the key words, then holds.

value.retentionDevice: A diagonal pair of changes inside 17 ms (TR smoke wipe from 7.633, BL cut at 7.650), then two more cuts at 9.183 and 9.650
value.content: TR: dark smoke swallows the white line; a small orb and a short answer line type on in the dark. BL: a finished, image-rich dashboard replaces the draft and reframes to show its sidebar. TL: the question keeps typing, the field scrolling to keep the caret fixed. BR: chat replies pile up, then a cut to a navy title card.

value.purpose: Density climax: every cell ends on a busy, real-looking interface
value.retentionDevice: Another diagonal pair (TR 10.067, BL 10.083), then TR 10.6 and BL 11.45; BR's cards arrive at shrinking intervals so the last second accelerates
value.content: TR: a logo mark becomes an app tile that opens into a calendar app. BL: a change-request field, a chip is clicked, then a cut to sky with a results table. TL: the send button is pressed (turns black, refills green from the bottom) while the assistant character hops above it. BR: the title fades into the first email card and a stack of cards cascades in.

payoff.value: In the last 1.5 s all four cells are full product interfaces at once (calendar app, results table, a sent question, a stack of email cards): the viewer leaves believing this studio can make any AI product look this good, which is the studio's claim without a word saying it.

callToAction.value: None on screen. The film ends on a full grid at F696 and drops to one black frame (F697, mean luma 0.0), which reads as a loop point or an export tail, not a designed end card.
evidence: mean luminance F696 176.4, F697 0.0 (computed from media/source.mp4)

whyItWorks: Four cells, staggered cuts: in 11.6 s there are 16 picture changes, but never more than two within 0.1 s, so something always changes and the frame never resets as a whole. The eye is always pulled to a new cell.
Changes come in diagonal pairs: TR and BL change together at 7.633/7.650 and 10.067/10.083, BR and TL 0.15 s apart at 5.017/5.167. Opposite corners keep the grid's weight balanced.
Each cell runs the same arc: an abstract opening, then a character or problem, then a real interface. Parallel arcs read as one method applied four times, which is the point of a portfolio piece.
Every line of text is typed or built in front of the viewer, never placed whole. A typing caret is the strongest attention magnet in a busy frame, and three of the four cells use one.
No voice and only one quiet-then-pulse music bed (inferred, not heard), so the clip works muted in a feed.
